WITH ops AS (
 SELECT o.*, ra.pool_id, ra.profile_id
 FROM logical_operations o
 JOIN service_routes r ON r.route_id=o.route_id AND r.service_id=2
 JOIN route_assignments ra ON ra.route_id=o.route_id AND o.opened_at_ms>=ra.effective_from_ms AND o.opened_at_ms<ra.effective_to_ms
 WHERE o.opened_at_ms>=1778148000000 AND o.opened_at_ms<1778155200000
), agg AS (

  count(*) ops,
  sum(CASE WHEN a.max_no IS NOT NULL AND fc.is_success=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) tf,
  sum(CASE WHEN n_att>1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) retried,

 JOIN (

     max(x.attempt_no) max_no,
